questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, tr.trStatus ORDER BY tr.trNumber
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.918'}) WHERE tr.conclusions IS NOT NULL RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.conclusions
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport) WHERE tr.trStatus = 'Completed' RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle ORDER BY tr.trNumber

questions.description: 특정 TR(38.903)이 영향 준 TS 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.903'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN s.specNumber, imp.impactType, imp.verifiedImpactScope ORDER BY s.specNumber
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.905'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact) RETURN imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription, imp.evidenceStatus, imp.verifiedImpactScope
questions.claim_contract: Stored claim inventory: return the declared impact type together with evidenceStatus; pending/rejected records are not established incorporation.

questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact {impactType: 'ExtendSection', evidenceStatus: 'source_verified', verifiedImpactScope: 'existing_section_change'}) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle ORDER BY tr.trNumber
questions.claim_contract: The proposed impactType is retained. This factual operation query requires the independently source-assessed verifiedImpactScope; published definition/analysis reuse alone does not establish creation or extension.

questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact {impactType: 'NoChange', evidenceStatus: 'source_verified', verifiedImpactScope: 'explicit_no_change'}) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle ORDER BY tr.trNumber
questions.claim_contract: The proposed impactType is retained. This factual operation query requires the independently source-assessed verifiedImpactScope; published definition/analysis reuse alone does not establish creation or extension.

questions.description: 특정 TS(38.521-1)에 영향 준 TR 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-1'}) RETURN tr.trNumber, imp.impactType, imp.verifiedImpactScope ORDER BY tr.trNumber

MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.903'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN tr.trNumber, s.specNumber, imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription, imp.verifiedImpactScope ORDER BY s.specNumber

MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.905'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN tr.trNumber, s.specNumber, imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription, imp.verifiedImpactScope ORDER BY s.specNumber

MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.918'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, tr.conclusions, imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription, imp.evidenceStatus, imp.verifiedImpactScope
questions.claim_contract: Research conclusions are source text. The stored NoChange claim is returned with its actual evidenceStatus; it does not establish a bounded negative claim.

questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-19'}) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle ORDER BY tr.trNumber

MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-1'}) RETURN tr.trNumber, imp.impactType, imp.verifiedImpactScope ORDER BY tr.trNumber

questions.description: 특정 TR이 참조하는 다른 TR 목록은? (38.903)
questions.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.903'})-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(ref:TechnicalReport) RETURN ref.trNumber, ref.trTitle ORDER BY ref.trNumber
questions.note: RAN5 TR 간 상호 인용 0 건(P5-V09) — 판정 근거는 absent_by_design_basis.
questions.question: 38.903이 참조하는 다른 TR은? (outgoing REFERENCES_TR)
questions.absent_by_design_basis: docs/tsg/RAN/formal/RAN5/phase-5/design-spec/tdoc_ontology_specs(TR).md P5-V09: RAN5 TR 3개(38.903 · 38.905 · 38.918)의 References 절에 서로를 가리키는 TR 인용이 없어 referencesTR 인스턴스가 0 이다 — 생산자 scripts/tsg/RAN/formal/RAN5/phase-5/tr-parser/01_parse_tr_docs.py 의 extract_tr_references 산출 ontology/output/tsg/RAN/formal/parsed_tr/RAN5/tr_documents.json 에서 세 TR 모두 referencesTR = []. 간선이 0 이면 Neo4j 에 관계 타입이 생기지 않는다. 인용이 생겨 적재되면 이 선언이 결함으로 뜬다.
